decision_rationale: Real scaled end-to-end generation for capability benchmarks is missing. What exists is (1) a layer-4-only CPU NumPy diagnostic with max 4 output tokens that self-labels diagnostic_cpu_only_not_tg_eligible, and (2) a single-position BOS (token_id=0, position=0) full 43-layer Metal forward that can emit one greedy token_id after ~41s. Neither path is a multi-token prefill+decode serving loop over arbitrary prompts. Closing the gap requires registered 43-layer causal executor work (position>0 KV continuation, full compressed attention graphs beyond BOS empty-topk, tokenizer/chat encode, sampling loop, serve adapter) — architecture/depth outside this task's thin-harness scope.
